name: CloudAxis

modes.label: Capped browser quota
modes.note: No overage; no independent per-hour tariff. Unspecified guest OS is not a selectable OS guarantee.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 50 AI credits, 10 cloud browser minutes, 10 web searches monthly; 2 specialist slots (Cloudia + 1); 2 scheduled jobs; no code execution; day-one bonus up to ~50 earned credits (~100 total), bonus pool cap 500.

plans.name: Growth
plans.note: 2,500 AI credits, 500 cloud browser minutes, 120 web searches/month; 5 specialist slots; full agent catalog; 300 AI posters; 2 AI videos; 75 WhatsApp sends; no code execution; bills immediately, non-refundable.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: 5,000 AI credits, 1,000 cloud browser minutes, 240 web searches/month; 10 specialist slots; code execution (Python/JS sandbox) from Pro; unlimited AI posters; 6 AI videos; 3 SEO audits/mo; 400 workspace files; bills immediately, no trial.

plans.name: Max
plans.note: 18,000 AI credits, 3,500 cloud browser minutes, 800 web searches/month; 50 specialist slots; code execution; unlimited AI posters; 20 AI videos; 20 SEO audits/mo; 2,000 workspace files; bills immediately, no trial.

features.ip_note: Cloud browser infrastructure is Browserbase (US subprocessor), not documented as running inside the account's workspace machine; sessions are geo-routed via automatic VPN/proxy 'from your country'. Residential vs datacenter IP type not documented.

caveats: Storage, snapshot GiB-month and public IPv 4 prices are not published in the reviewed sources; null is not free.

No guaranteed vCPU allocation published; browser-hour is not a verified 4-vCPU/8-GiB VM equivalent. The sizes card keeps unknown hardware null; do not coerce it to zero or auto-rank against resource-guaranteed VMs.
Browser RAM is not published unless a specific mode overrides it.
Specialist slots are not a documented simultaneous-browser limit. Keep browser concurrency null, rather than 50 on Max.
Persistent workspace UI and code execution do not prove a dedicated 4/8 VM or full OS desktop. Runtime/browser and AI/search quotas are separate hard caps.
Current Auto Mode model selection is bundled; underlying token costs cannot be replaced by a flat browser-hour equivalent.
Browser time is double-metered: each cloud-browser session consumes browser minutes AND AI credits ('each session draws from your monthly credits'); either cap can stop work first.
Credit burn per action is not fixed: since the week of 25 Sep 2026 AI-credit metering scales with upstream model costs (plan caps unchanged), so the same credit allowance can buy less work.

No annual billing option: /pricing/ has no monthly/annual toggle (puppeteer found no toggle controls; zero 'annual/yearly' mentions). Monthly only; paid plans bill immediately, no trial, payments non-refundable.
Duties can run at most once every 15 minutes; scheduled-duty slots are account-wide per plan (Free 2). Plan-level default per-run runtime and credit caps exist but values are unpublished.

fleet.verification: Free signup explicitly says no credit card required.
fleet.notes: Specialist slots and browser-minute budgets are not documented concurrent browser/VM account quotas. Free needs no card; no fleet quota-increase ladder established.
